annotation body

  • CURIE: gmeow:annotationBody
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/annotationBody
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/notes
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The note that serves as the body of an annotation — the content being attached. Functional per relator: one body per Annotation. Optional: a highlight or bookmark has no body.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Annotation -> gmeow:Note; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:annotationBody from gmeow:Annotation to gmeow:Note when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Annotation, gmeow:Note
